_comment: How a device's display name is composed. 'templates': 'product_label' when a product is known and the device has a friendly name that is a LABEL (a room, a person, a nickname: it adds something the brand and model do not say); 'product' when it has no such label; 'kind_label' / 'kind' when only the kind of device is known ('ESPHome light', 'smart plug'). Placeholders: {brand} {product} {kind} {friendly}; empty ones collapse. 'display_product': [regex, replacement] rewrites of the product for the display name only (the 'product' field keeps the full name). 'synonyms': words that mean the same as a product/brand word, so a friendly name made only of them ('Хромкаст', 'Television') is not a label. 'filler': words that never make a name a label. Override any key with load_naming(extra=...) or a local naming.json.
